item.title: GuocoLand to preview River Modern with prices starting from $2,877 psf
item.description: Singapore-listed GuocoLand is set to preview its latest project, the 455-unit River Modern, on Feb 20, with the public launch scheduled for Mar 7. item.title: Metro sells 26% stake in Boustead Industrial Fund ahead of proposed UI Boustead REIT listing
item.description: Metro Holdings is divesting its 26% interest in the Boustead Industrial Fund (BIF). The sale comes ahead of Boustead Singapore’s proposed listing of UI Boustead REIT (UIB REIT). BIF is a private real estate trust that owns 15 industrial, business park, high-spec industrial and logistics properties across Singapore with a combined net lettable area of about 2.2 million sq ft. Twelve of the properties are wholly-owned by BIF. The other three properties are 49% held by BIF through holding entities.

item.title: AI-related infrastructure among top targets for institutional investors: Nuveen
item.description: Infrastructure supporting AI, including data centres and cloud infrastructure, are among the top opportunities that are being actively pursued by institutional investors, based on findings from a survey by global asset manager Nuveen. item.description: London-based real estate agency chain Chestertons Global is partnering with Rahim & Co International Property Consultants, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, to strengthen its capabilities across valuation and consultancy in Malaysia. item.title: Pair of luxury condo units sold for $23.89 mil at Seven Palms Sentosa Cove
item.description: Two units stacked vertically at the ultra-luxury beachfront residential development, Seven Palms Sentosa Cove, have changed hands for a combined $23.89 million, scooped up by a Singaporean, Lee Shih Hua. The purchase price works out to about $2,717 psf based on the combined strata area of 8,794 sq ft. item.title: CapitaLand Investment grows funds under management to $125 bil in FY2025, to accelerate capital recycling in 2026
item.description: CapitaLand Investment (CLI) closed its FY2025, which ended Dec 31, 2025, with funds under management (FUM) totalling $125 billion, up 7% y-o-y from $117 billion in FY2024. The growth was driven by both its private and listed funds, with total equity raised almost doubling to $6.5 billion last year.
